summary.text: Lanell Griffith is the Republican candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 55 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Tobias Schlingensiepen.
Her campaign website lists affordability, with a focus on property tax relief, growth, and the defense of constitutional rights as her campaign pillars.

paragraphs.text: Lanell Griffith says on her campaign website that she home schooled her sons for six years, until her youngest graduated from high school in May.

She describes her background as including coordinating fitness and wellness programs for worksites, restoring houses to sell and teaching, as well as serving as an officer in Republican grassroots organizing.
Griffith advanced from the Republican primary for District 55 on August 4, 2026, receiving 1,233 votes in a race with no other Republican candidate.
